# Journey Checklist: Ordering Journey (Tasks 6–8)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review gate for the ordering journey spec before planning
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: specs/010-ordering-journey/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are pre-order enablement requirements specified per product with timing content defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are pre-order identification requirements specified for placement before ordering controls? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are snapshot requirements specified for pre-order facts alongside option and currency snapshots? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are minimal-detail requirements specified per field with delivery-only gating rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are review-step requirements specified for lines, options, notes, subtotal, fee, and total? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are transition requirements specified for every valid move plus terminal immutability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "plain non-immediate-availability explanation" defined with required content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "message-only timing" defined with length and content boundaries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "no extra steps" quantified against the existing checkout step count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "simple timeline" defined with required states per variant (pickup, delivery, pre-order)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "best-effort notification" for realtime events defined with recovery expectations? [Clarity, Spec §Realtime Event]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Are pre-order requirements consistent between identification, checkout, snapshot, and timeline sections? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are money requirements consistent between server-truth pricing, currency context, and no-conversion rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are terminal-state requirements consistent between transition enforcement and history preservation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are guest-checkout requirements consistent across pre-order, optioned, and simple lines? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Can SC-003 pre-order correctness be verified for identification, timing, snapshots, and timeline? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK017 - Can SC-004 zero-duplicate/zero-partial be tested via retry and failure injection? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-005 transition reflection be verified jointly across dashboard, events, and timeline? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 - Can SC-006 codeless tracking be verified for all three order variants? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are SC-001 time bounds scoped with defined start and end points? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are primary-flow requirements defined for the full link-to-tracked-order journey? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are alternate-flow requirements defined for mixed carts (simple, optioned, pre-order)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are exception-flow requirements defined for stale pre-order claims and failed validations? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are recovery requirements defined for SSE loss and mid-cart rule changes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for wrong-type state attempts (e.g. delivery-only on pickup)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
